rows.value: IIBDGC European IBD GWAS (Liu 2015, public summary statistics)
rows.quote: The GWAS datasets with IBD were obtained from the international inflammatory bowel disease genetic consortium (IIBDGC).[20] The IBD datasets (encompassing diverse subtypes IBD, UC, and CD) were consisted of individuals of European ancestry.
rows.reference_quote: Liu JZ, van Sommeren S, Huang H, et al. ; International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics, I.B.D.G.C. International. Association analyses identify 38 susceptibility loci for inflammatory bowel disease and highlight shared genetic risk across populations. Nat Genet 2015;47:979–86.
rows.coder_note: Reference 20 is Liu 2015 (DOI 10.1038/ng.3359), a source with two dictionary rows; the pinned sentence states the datasets are of European ancestry, which matches only the European GWAS row and not the trans-ethnic row (rule E); the next sentence gives that row's IBD 12,882/21,770 and UC 6968/20,464, and its CD 5950 against the row's 5,956 identifies no other release (rule H).
